machine: SP11 Windows same physical X1E80100 device

irq_ack.classification: post-status-clear ISR acknowledgement, not a pre-reset write

device_config_runtime_order: CSID reset command 4 -> TOP mask 1 -> RESET_CFG 0x11 -> RESET_CMD 2 -> wait
CSID config command 6 -> full Gen2 builder RVA 0x1a870

linux_current_mismatch.route_relative_to_reset: Linux route is programmed during stream prepare after reset; Windows programs route before reset.
linux_current_mismatch.reset_cmd: Linux CSID680 uses HW_RESET|SW_RESET = 3; Windows normal CSID reset uses software-only = 2.
linux_current_mismatch.irq_cmd: Linux prewrites IRQ_CMD_CLEAR before reset; Windows normal reset callback has no +0x14 write. Windows +0x14=1 is ISR acknowledgement.
linux_current_mismatch.post_reset_generic_masks: Linux csid_reset writes generic RDI/IPP/BUF/TOP masks after reset; Windows proceeds from reset completion into exact full configure without that generic all-mask staging.

linux_consequence: For the bounded SP11 front CSID1 path, represent the Windows common lifecycle before another runtime: program wrapper route 0x101 before reset; use RESET_CFG 0x11 and software-only RESET_CMD 2 with TOP mask 1; do not prewrite IRQ_CMD; after reset do not stage generic all-path masks before the exact front configure. Keep the existing ISR IRQ_CMD acknowledgement. Scope the delta to the same-machine X1E CSID1 front path unless broader parity is separately proven.
